## 3. Size / cost estimates
- MEASURED: per-POV route = 165,270 files; sum(sidecar_bytes) = 26.63 GB (the 3 probe files were 97% of sidecar_bytes => ~25.8 GB actual, ESTIMATE).
- MEASURED (Hub API listing, nothing downloaded): map-level route = 794 files, 18.09 GB total, median 22.4 MB, range 10.7-52.6 MB.
- ESTIMATE (assumes the column-byte shares of the probe file hold for all maps; parquet has ONE row group per file, so whole column chunks are read but unused columns are skipped): proposed columns = 60% of bytes = 10.9 GB; + velocity_z/yaw/pitch = 82% = 14.9 GB.
- MEASURED file counts/sizes by Step-2 series split (full files), proposed-column estimate alongside:

```
       files     GB  GB_proposed_cols_est
split                                    
train    555  12.63                  7.60
val      119   2.67                  1.61
test     120   2.79                  1.68
```

- Phase-A pilot = all val+test series + 1/3 of train series: 421 files, 9.6 GB full / ~5.8 GB with column projection (ESTIMATE).
- ESTIMATE: total tick rows ~629M (975,502 rows / 28.07 MB in the probe file); raw float32 in RAM ~25-30 GB => process map by map and keep only snapshots at the prediction ticks (+ short look-back windows), never the raw ticks.
- ASSUMPTION (unmeasured): download time is bandwidth/rate-limit bound; footer read took 3.4 s and a 12-column read of a 28 MB file took 4.8 s here => roughly 1-2 h sequential for all 794 files, less with a few parallel workers.
